---
title: "What is the wing loading with the ballast fitted?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 60.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 120.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 10.4      # s the probe actually used

plane = get_airplane()
mass_props = get_mass_properties(plane)
mass = mass_props[0]
s_ref = plane.s_ref
wing_loading = mass / s_ref
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{wing_loading:.2f} kg/m²"`]{.hero-value}
[wing loading]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The wing loading is `{python} f"{wing_loading:.2f} kg/m²"`. With the wings moved aft, [no nose ballast is required](2026-09-24-01-how-much-nose-ballast-is-needed-with-wings-at-the-rear.qmd) for balance, so the `{python} f"{mass*1000:.1f} g"` flying mass consists entirely of the airframe. The reference wing area is `{python} f"{s_ref:.4f} m²"`.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
footer(get_mass_properties)
```
